capabilities: visualize hotkeys on a keyboard layout
search hotkeys by key combo, command name, plugin, or scope
highlight duplicate assignments and unassigned keys
overlay system and editor default shortcuts
disambiguation: Not a system-wide keyboard or macro tool; it only visualizes and manages hotkeys inside Obsidian.
extras: The hotkey edit mode is marked [ALPHA] and grouping [WIP]; the roadmap lists settings migration and more key support as pending. Also installable via BRAT or manually from Releases. No analytics; accepts Ko-fi donations.
intentEvidence: Visualize, search, and analyze your Obsidian hotkeys on a keyboard layout.
problem: Obsidian's hotkey settings are a flat list, so it is hard to see which keys are free, which are double-assigned, or which collide with OS/editor shortcuts.
summary: Keyboard-layout viewer that maps Obsidian hotkeys, highlighting duplicate keys, unassigned gaps, and collisions with system defaults.
